subject: french
title: Travel and Holidays
welcome_lead: The IBDP theme Experiences covers travel, leisure and life events. Describing journeys builds the past tenses you need.
meta_desc: IBDP French: Experiences — travel, holidays, past tense narration.
final_note: A holiday told well in French is half the journey.

concepts.def: Stay — period spent at a destination.
Change of scenery — feeling of being elsewhere.

walkthroughs.body_html: Use passe compose for completed actions (j'ai visite le Louvre) and imparfait for descriptions or repeated actions (il faisait beau, nous nous reposions).
Start with context (l'ete dernier), use connectors (ensuite, soudain, finalement), and reflect at the end: cette experience m'a marque.
Discuss le tourisme de masse vs le tourisme durable. Useful: d'un cote... mais d'un autre cote...

mcqs.q: Which tense is used for completed past actions?

numericals.q: How many auxiliary verbs in French passe compose (avoir/etre)?
